_comment: Voice config (spec §4). provider talks to a swappable VoiceProvider interface.

prebaked.name: higgsfield
prebaked._note: Vlad (Higgsfield seed_audio) — fixed narration lines pre-rendered into .cache/tts/ via scripts/bake-audio.mjs. Used automatically when ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is absent; dynamic {NAME}/{ROLE} lines fall back to browser TTS. Set the key to voice every line at runtime instead.

_notes: narrator_voice_id defaults to a deep prebuilt voice (Adam) so it works the moment ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is set. For the real smoky Silas, create a custom voice with the Voice Design prompt in the README/voice-bible and paste its voice id here. An invalid id simply falls back to browser TTS. eleven_flash_v2_5 = ~75ms latency; use eleven_v3 for pre-rendered high-quality lines. NEVER put the API key in this file — it lives only in the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY env var.
